hero.heading: Data Science Society
hero.subtext: We turn passionate students into innovative leaders. Through hands-on projects with real industry partners and mentorship from experienced members, we'll help you build the skills and portfolio to break into the field.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: DSS is UC Berkeley's premier student organization for data science and machine learning. We are a community where students learn by doing, grow through mentorship, and build careers by impactfully applying technology in the fields they most care about.

photo.alt: DSS members on the UC Berkeley campus
photo.caption: DSS Spring 2025 Members

items.title: Find your committee.
items.body: Acadev, Consulting, and Social Good are the three committees within our organization. Pick the one that best fits your interest and apply to join it!

image.alt: DSS members gathered on the UC Berkeley campus

items.title: Start with the DeCal.
items.body: New to Berkeley, or still deciding whether data science is for you? Our project-based DeCal is a low-stakes way to find out, and no experience is required!

image.alt: DeCal students presenting their final project to the class in a Berkeley lecture hall
